articles.title: Lift Out of Service at Derker Tram Stop
articles.excerpt: The lift at Derker tram stop is currently out of service, affecting access for passengers travelling towards and away from Manchester.
articles.content_html:
A lift at Derker tram stop is out of service until further notice, as of 8:14am on 12 August 2026. This disruption affects passengers using the tram service.

For those travelling towards Manchester, step-free access is available via a ramp from Cromford Street to the Manchester-bound platform. Passengers heading away from Manchester can also use a ramp from Cromford Street and must cross the tracks to reach the Rochdale-bound platform.

Transport for Greater Manchester has apologised for any inconvenience caused by this disruption and is providing alternative access routes for passengers.
